flawless: First arrow, last arrow, only arrow. You never got a shot off.
The canopy is our fortress, and you never once pierced it.
solid: Good shooting from the ground, human. Better from the branches.
You drew blood from the treetops. Few do.
close: Our quivers are empty and our bowstrings frayed. That was too close.
Gaea steadied our hands at the end. Without her, we'd have fallen.
